name: plan-tasks-drift-inferred-from-missing-row
body: apg_plan_tasks infers an absent assigned Agent from a missing AssignedTo row — the ingest projection drops the edge when the Agent node is absent, so the intended agent FQN is unrecoverable from the graph. Limit: drift detection names only "(drift)", not the missing Agent FQN. Upgrade if the Task record ever carries the assignment as a property: then the drift display can name the missing FQN.
